_method: OWApp (github.com/Mobile-IoT-Security-Lab/OWApp-Benchmarking-Suite, OWApp/apk/ListedAPKs, MIT). One intentionally vulnerable APK per OWASP MASTG test; there are no fixed versions, so only detection (recall) is measured. Unit = app. Detected if the scan has a finding in one of the expected categories. Expected categories were written from each test's MASTG title and README before any scan, and committed before the first run. 'out_of_scope' = no AndroGuard rule targets that test.

MASTG-TEST0008.out_of_scope: sensitive data shown in the UI: no rule

MASTG-TEST0011.out_of_scope: sensitive data in memory: runtime, not static

MASTG-TEST0026.out_of_scope: implicit intents carrying data: no rule

MASTG-TEST0040.out_of_scope: debugging symbols in native code: no rule

MASTG-TEST0041.out_of_scope: debugging code and verbose logging: no rule

MASTG-TEST0043.out_of_scope: memory corruption in native code: no rule

MASTG-TEST0044.out_of_scope: native compiler security flags: no rule

MASTG-TEST0048.out_of_scope: reverse-engineering tool detection: resilience, no rule
